summary: Round 2 testing of 4 new features + regression. Backend: all 27 pytest tests pass (20 regression + 7 new: /api/rates, /api/rates/refresh, /api/settings rates_updated, /api/transactions/bulk x2, /api/paycheck, /api/expenses/breakdown). Live FX works - EUR=0.8917 (not static 0.92), rates_updated populated. Paycheck allocation verified: bills+savings+spending within $1.5 of amount per row. Frontend: demo login works, Paycheck Planner page shows 4 KPIs (pay-total/bills/savings/spending), stacked bar chart, and table (7+ visible rows). Expense Explorer renders donut, 11 clickable categories, trend chart updates on category click, drill-down transaction list populates. Setup page shows Live exchange rates panel with LIVE badge, per-currency cards (rate-USD/EUR/GBP/INR/CAD/AUD/JPY/CNY/CHF/SGD) and Refresh rates button that triggers POST /api/rates/refresh (toast 'Exchange rates updated'). CSV import flow works end-to-end: import-csv-btn opens import-modal, csv-file-input accepts file, preview shows, confirm-import-btn POSTs /api/transactions/bulk and the 3 TEST_CSV_* rows appear in the Transactions list; negative amount -25.50 was persisted as expense per CSV spec. Regression nav (dashboard, debt, ai, monthly, annual) all load without errors.

issues: Hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - carried over from iteration 1, dev-tool x-source injection, user-invisible.

action_items: Optional/minor: Paycheck table row data-testid is 'paycheck-row-<id>' but review request mentioned 'pay-row-<id>'. KPIs match spec (pay-total, pay-bills, pay-savings, pay-spending). Decide if naming should be aligned.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1005 lines (new rates, bulk, paycheck, expenses endpoints) - well past the 700-line threshold. Strongly recommend splitting into routers/ and services/ modules.
refresh_rates() uses blocking requests.get in executor - acceptable but httpx.AsyncClient would be cleaner.

LIVE_RATES is a process-local dict - fine for single-instance; if scaled to multiple backend replicas each would have its own stale cache. Consider caching rates in MongoDB with TTL for horizontal scaling.
/api/transactions/bulk performs no per-row validation feedback - rejects or accepts whole batch via Pydantic; no partial-success report returned to UI (just inserted count). Acceptable for MVP.
convert() rounds to 2dp per hop - fine for USD/EUR but introduces small drift for JPY (zero-decimal currencies) and chained conversions.
seed_data_creation: CSV import test uploaded 3 TEST_CSV_* transactions; cleaned up via DELETE /api/transactions/{id} at end of test run. Pytest TestBulkTxn also inserts+deletes TEST_BULK_* rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now cover 27 tests (added TestRates, TestBulkTxn, TestPaycheck, TestExpenseBreakdown). Live FX fetches from https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD on startup and on-demand; EUR currently ~0.8917. Paycheck table row testid is 'paycheck-row-<id>' (not 'pay-row-<id>'). CSV import flow: import-csv-btn -> import-modal -> csv-file-input (type=file) -> preview -> confirm-import-btn -> POST /api/transactions/bulk.
